title: Reissert compound studies. XXXIX. A novel approach to the berbine and 6‐azaberbine systems and related derivatives of ellipticine
abstract: AbstractA new synthetic method for the construction of the berbine, 6‐azaberbine, and indoloberbine ring skeletons is reported. Treatment of heterocyclic bases such as isoquinolines, phthalazines, and ellipticine with 2‐chloromethylbenzoyl chloride and trimethylsilyl cyanide gave the corresponding Reissert compounds. Treatment of these Reissert compounds with sodium hydride resulted in intramolecular cyclization with loss of hydrogen cyanide.
